snippet.title: She Rules the Night – Vampire RPG Character First Look | Harrowed World: Portents In Red
snippet.description:
As promised, here’s the character reveal you’ve all been waiting for, introducing a key figure in ‘Harrowed World: Portents In Red’, our Modern Gothic Vampire RPG currently in development.

Bella Quillan is the undisputed leader of the vampires who call the Isle of Gallow home, at least those aligned with the alliance that governs their secret society. Beautiful, commanding, and impossibly powerful, she embodies deadly elegance and the heart of a storm.

Featuring the voice of Trynity Byrd aka Psychedel.

Music from 'Harrowed World: Portents In Red' Official Soundtrack Composed by Stefan Sima. 

Live a dark fantasy with supernatural strength, animal transformation, and mental influence. Danger is everywhere, and trust is a rare commodity. Choose your allies and enemies well.

Good luck, vampire

Wishlist 'Harrowed World: Portents In Red':
